title: Topological Tverberg theorems for products of polytopes
summary: The topological Tverberg theorem asserts that if $r$ is a prime power then for any continuous map $f\colon Δ_{(r-1)(d+1)}\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^d$ from the $(r-1)(d+1)$-dimensional simplex $Δ_{(r-1)(d+1)}$ to $\mathbb{R}^d$ there exist $r$ pairwise disjoint faces of the simplex whose images have non-empty $r$-fold intersection. By refinement, the same conclusion holds if the simplex is replaced by any polytope of the same dimension. While this dimension is tight for simplices, recent work of Soberón and Zerbib shows that this need not be true for polytopes in general. Here we give…
